metadata.title: Upgrades LetterOfCredit and TimeBasedCollateralPool contracts
metadata.description:
Upgrades LetterOfCredit and TimeBasedCollateralPool contracts
  
  1a. Removes V0 LetterOfCredit contract (0x1A3251d83B4ed97d8E1d8451613D7DD9B4f42961) from being supported within the CollateralVault 
  1b. Adds V1 LetterOfCredit [proxy] contract (0x14db9a91933aD9433E1A0dB04D08e5D9EF7c4808) as supported within the CollateralVault 
  2. Upgrades TBCP beacon implementation to 0xCc437a7Bb14f07de09B0F4438df007c8F64Cf29f, upgrading all TBCP beacon proxies at once
  3. Re-initializes CollateralVault withdrawal fee to 0 ahead of launch.

https://forum.anvil.xyz/t/proposal-omnibus-protocol-upgrades-for-launch/108

metadata.title: Initial Letter Of Credit Related Configurations
metadata.description:
Initial Letter Of Credit Related Configurations
0. Adds LetterOfCredit contract as an authorized collateralizable contract in the CollateralVault contract
1. Adds USDC, USDT, and WETH as supported credited tokens within the LetterOfCredit contract
    * USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48): minPerLOC: 100,000,000, maxPerLOC: 100,000,000,000, globalMaxInUse: 10,000,000,000,000
    * USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7): minPerLOC: 100,000,000, maxPerLOC: 100,000,000,000, globalMaxInUse: 10,000,000,000,000
    * WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2): minPerLOC: 28,000,000,000,000,000, maxPerLOC: 30,000,000,000,000,000,000, globalMaxInUse: 3,000,000,000,000,000,000,000
2. Adds AssetPairCollateralFactors for all collateral/credited token pairs in LetterOfCredit contract
    (0) collateralToken: USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), creditedToken: USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7), creation CF basis points: 7500, liquidation CF basis points: 8500, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
    (1) collateralToken: USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), creditedToken: WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2), creation CF basis points: 6500, liquidation CF basis points: 7800, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
    (2) collateralToken: USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7), creditedToken: USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), creation CF basis points: 7500, liquidation CF basis points: 8500, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
    (3) collateralToken: USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7), creditedToken: WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2), creation CF basis points: 6500, liquidation CF basis points: 7800, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
    (4) collateralToken: WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2), creditedToken: USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), creation CF basis points: 6500, liquidation CF basis points: 7800, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
    (5) collateralToken: WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2), creditedToken: USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7), creation CF basis points: 6500, liquidation CF basis points: 7800, liquidator incentive basis points: 800
3. Updates the maximum LOC duration to 500 days
4. Adds Pyth Feed IDs for USDC/USD, USDT/USD, and WETH/USD to PythPriceOracle adapter contract
    * USDC(0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48) pyth price feed ID: 0xeaa020c61cc479712813461ce153894a96a6c00b21ed0cfc2798d1f9a9e9c94a
    * USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7) pyth price feed ID: 0x2b89b9dc8fdf9f34709a5b106b472f0f39bb6ca9ce04b0fd7f2e971688e2e53b
    * WETH(0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2) pyth price feed ID: 0x9d4294bbcd1174d6f2003ec365831e64cc31d9f6f15a2b85399db8d5000960f6

For more information, see Anvil Forum post: https://forum.anvil.xyz/t/proposal-initial-letter-of-credit-related-configurations/85
